sql: SELECT event_id, magnitude FROM events WHERE region_id = 1 AND magnitude >= 3.0 ORDER BY magnitude DESC, event_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE event_type = 'earthquake'
SELECT AVG(depth_km) FROM events WHERE review_status = 'reviewed' AND magnitude >= 3.0

SELECT mt.description, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM events e JOIN magnitude_types mt ON e.mag_type_code = mt.mag_type_code WHERE e.review_status = 'reviewed' AND e.tsunami_flag = 0 GROUP BY mt.description ORDER BY event_count DESC, mt.description ASC

SELECT r.region_name, AVG(i.felt_reports) AS avg_felt_reports FROM events e JOIN event_impacts i ON e.event_id = i.event_id JOIN regions r ON e.region_id = r.region_id WHERE i.felt_reports > 0 GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY avg_felt_reports DESC, r.region_name ASC

SELECT n.network_name, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM events e JOIN networks n ON e.net_code = n.net_code WHERE e.event_type = 'earthquake' GROUP BY n.network_name ORDER BY event_count DESC, n.network_name ASC

SELECT r.region_name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN e.review_status = 'reviewed' AND e.tsunami_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_reviewed_tsunami FROM events e JOIN regions r ON e.region_id = r.region_id GROUP BY r.region_id, r.region_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY pct_reviewed_tsunami DESC, r.region_name ASC

SELECT region_name, event_id, magnitude, significance FROM (SELECT r.region_name, e.event_id, e.magnitude, e.significance, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.region_id ORDER BY e.significance DESC, e.event_id ASC) AS rn FROM events e JOIN regions r ON e.region_id = r.region_id) WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY region_name ASC

WITH ra AS (SELECT region_id, AVG(magnitude) AS avg_mag FROM events GROUP BY region_id) SELECT e.event_id, r.region_name, e.magnitude, ra.avg_mag AS regional_avg_magnitude FROM events e JOIN ra ON e.region_id = ra.region_id JOIN regions r ON e.region_id = r.region_id WHERE e.magnitude >= ra.avg_mag + 0.5 ORDER BY r.region_name ASC, e.magnitude DESC, e.event_id ASC
SELECT event_id, event_time, depth_km FROM events WHERE region_id = 2 AND review_status = 'reviewed' AND depth_km < 10.0 ORDER BY event_time ASC
SELECT MAX(significance) AS max_significance FROM events WHERE tsunami_flag = 0 AND magnitude >= 3.0
SELECT COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM events WHERE event_type = 'earthquake' AND num_stations >= 50

SELECT r.region_type, ROUND(AVG(e.magnitude), 2) AS avg_magnitude FROM events e JOIN regions r ON e.region_id = r.region_id WHERE e.review_status = 'reviewed' AND e.event_type = 'earthquake' AND e.magnitude >= 3.0 GROUP BY r.region_type ORDER BY r.region_type ASC

SELECT mt.description, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM events e JOIN magnitude_types mt ON e.mag_type_code = mt.mag_type_code WHERE e.tsunami_flag = 1 AND e.significance >= 100 GROUP BY mt.description ORDER BY event_count DESC, mt.description ASC

SELECT r.region_name, ROUND(AVG(i.community_intensity), 2) AS avg_community_intensity FROM events e JOIN event_impacts i ON e.event_id = i.event_id JOIN regions r ON e.region_id = r.region_id WHERE i.felt_reports >= 2 GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY avg_community_intensity DESC, r.region_name ASC
